# fitted_platformer_controller.gd  (Godot 4.x)
# Generated by Reference Controller Fitter {{VERSION}} on {{DATE}}.
# Candidate model: {{MODEL}}   Fit trajectory error: {{FIT_ERROR}}   Confidence: {{CONFIDENCE}}
#
# A behaviourally similar platformer controller fitted to reference footage (not the
# original game's code). Attach to a CharacterBody2D with a CollisionShape2D.
# Parameters are in world units (1 unit = {{UNIT_NOTE}}); `pixels_per_unit` converts to
# Godot pixels. Controls: ui_left / ui_right (or A/D if mapped) and ui_accept / Space to jump.
# Note: Godot resolves collisions with move_and_slide(), so landing happens at the physics
# frame boundary (the fitter's integrator lands mid-step); the difference is < 1 frame.
extends CharacterBody2D

@export var pixels_per_unit: float = {{PPU}}
# --- Horizontal (units/s, units/s^2)
@export var max_speed: float = {{max_speed}}
@export var ground_accel: float = {{ground_accel}}
@export var ground_decel: float = {{ground_decel}}
@export var turn_accel: float = {{turn_accel}}
# --- Vertical
@export var jump_velocity: float = {{jump_velocity}}
@export var rise_gravity: float = {{rise_gravity}}
@export var fall_gravity: float = {{fall_gravity}}
@export_range(0.0, 1.0) var jump_cut: float = {{jump_cut}}
@export var release_gravity_mult: float = {{release_gravity_mult}}
@export var apex_gravity_mult: float = {{apex_gravity_mult}}
@export var apex_threshold: float = {{apex_threshold}}
@export var max_fall_speed: float = {{max_fall_speed}}  # 0 = unlimited
# --- Air
@export var air_control: float = {{air_control}}

var vx: float = 0.0
var vy: float = 0.0  # y up, units/s
var grounded: bool = false
var jump_active: bool = false
var jump_held: bool = false


func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	var u: int = int(Input.is_action_pressed("ui_right")) - int(Input.is_action_pressed("ui_left"))
	var jump: bool = Input.is_action_pressed("ui_accept")
	if grounded and not is_on_floor():
		grounded = false
		jump_active = false
		vy = 0.0
	if jump and not jump_held and grounded:
		vy = jump_velocity
		grounded = false
		jump_active = true
	if not jump and jump_held:
		if jump_active and vy > 0.0:
			vy *= jump_cut
		jump_active = false
	jump_held = jump

	var d: Vector2 = _advance(u, jump_held, delta)
	# displacement (units, y up) -> pixel velocity (y down) for move_and_slide
	velocity = Vector2(d.x, -d.y) * pixels_per_unit / delta
	move_and_slide()
	if is_on_floor() and vy <= 0.0:
		grounded = true
		vy = 0.0
		jump_active = false
	if is_on_ceiling() and vy > 0.0:
		vy = 0.0
		jump_active = false
	if is_on_wall():
		vx = 0.0


func _max_fall() -> float:
	return max_fall_speed if max_fall_speed > 0.0 else INF


func _gravity(held: bool) -> float:
	var g: float
	if vy > 0.0:
		g = rise_gravity
		if not held:
			g *= release_gravity_mult
	else:
		g = fall_gravity
	if held and apex_gravity_mult != 1.0 and apex_threshold > 0.0 and absf(vy) <= apex_threshold:
		g *= apex_gravity_mult
	return g


# Exact piecewise-constant-acceleration integrator (port of the fitter's model).
func _advance(u: int, held: bool, h: float) -> Vector2:
	var x: float = 0.0
	var y: float = 0.0
	var remaining: float = h
	var mf: float = _max_fall()
	var it: int = 0
	while remaining > 1e-7 and it < 64:
		it += 1
		var mult: float = 1.0 if grounded else air_control
		var target: float
		var rate: float
		if u == 0:
			target = 0.0
			rate = ground_decel * mult
		elif vx * u < 0.0:
			target = 0.0
			rate = turn_accel * mult
		else:
			target = u * max_speed
			rate = (ground_decel if absf(vx) > max_speed else ground_accel) * mult
		var dv: float = target - vx
		var ax: float = 0.0
		var tx: float = INF
		if dv != 0.0 and rate > 0.0:
			ax = rate if dv > 0.0 else -rate
			tx = absf(dv) / rate
		var ay: float = 0.0
		var ty: float = INF
		if not grounded:
			if vy <= -mf:
				vy = -mf
			else:
				var g: float = _gravity(held)
				ay = -g
				var nxt: float = -mf
				if 0.0 < vy and 0.0 > nxt:
					nxt = 0.0
				if apex_threshold > 0.0:
					if apex_threshold < vy and apex_threshold > nxt:
						nxt = apex_threshold
					if -apex_threshold < vy and -apex_threshold > nxt:
						nxt = -apex_threshold
				if g > 0.0 and not is_inf(nxt):
					ty = (vy - nxt) / g
		var seg: float = minf(minf(remaining, tx), ty)
		x += vx * seg + 0.5 * ax * seg * seg
		vx += ax * seg
		if seg == tx:
			vx = target
		if not grounded:
			y += vy * seg + 0.5 * ay * seg * seg
			vy += ay * seg
			if seg == ty:
				vy -= 1e-5
		if vy <= 0.0:
			jump_active = false
		remaining -= seg
	return Vector2(x, y)
